messages:
rachel: FYI support ticket: fncall validator rejects are being billed to our generic /chat.generate route in the console. customer noticed quota bump.

dmitri: can you drop a req id so we can trace?

rachel: req id c9d7f0b3, 2026-06-11T13:22:10Z. payload: POST /v1/chat/completions with functions math(schema) then server returns {"error":"invalid_function_output", "details":"expected object got array"} and console shows /chat.generate billed.

ops-bot: dry-run query 2026-06-10T00:00 -> 2026-06-11T14:00 UTC predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" => 94 matches. CSV: ops:/tmp/fncall_mislabels_94.csv (dry-run).

dmitri: quick root cause: streaming refactor moved route-resolve after validation so validation emits before route metadata set. default route is /chat.generate, hence misattribution.

infra: mitigation options: 1) move route-resolve earlier (risky for stream path), 2) populate x-route-hint at ingress and have validator prefer it (low-risk), 3) post-process billing to remap (accounting risky).

dmitri: prefer #2 + a short-lived fallback shim. Plan: inject x-route-hint in auth middleware from route table; update validator to read header and include route_hint in error payload. Also add shim: if error_kind==invalid_function_output and no route_hint, set billing.route=/fncall before emitting billing event. Both behind ff preserve-route-before-validate.

rachel: ok. what about tests and rollout?

dmitri: will add unit tests for header logic + e2e that simulates fncall output mismatch asserting billing.route is /fncall. Feature-flagged deploy: canary 5% hosted/dedicated for 6h, monitor mislabel rate.

infra: observability note: add temporary dashboard metric mislabels_per_hr and an alert >5/hr in the canary cohort. Also emit a sampling flag in validator errors so we can backfill safely.

billing: we need a per-customer breakdown for reconciliation. ops-bot: once canary green run backfill dry-run and produce CSV grouped by customer.

ops-bot: acknowledged. will run backfill dry-run post-canary and notify @billing.

dmitri: i'll open PR today with header injection + validator change + shim + migration template. will include logs snippet, unit/e2e, and FF gating. plz review quickly.

rachel: thanks. i'll post a short note to support and prep KB explaining the reconciliation approach once PR is merged. :thumbsup:
